content.text:
**尼基·劳达（Niki Lauda）** 驾驶 Brabham BT46B 风扇车赢得了 1978 年瑞典大奖赛；这场比赛于 6 月 17 日在安德斯托普（Anderstorp）举行，这也是这款风扇车唯一一次参赛。

依据：
- Motorsport Magazine：“1978 Swedish GP: Brabham fan car wins its one and only race” — 1st Niki Lauda (Brabham-Alfa Romeo)  
  https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/special-article/the-75-greatest-grands-prix/6/75-1978-swedish-gp-brabham-fan-car-wins-its-one-and-only-race/
- Motor Sport 1978 年 7 月赛事报道：“N. Lauda (Brabham BT46/6B) 1 hr. 41 min. 00.606 sec.”  
  https://www.riccardopatrese.com/1978-swedish-gp/
